title: Launch HN: Nia (YC S25) – Give better context to coding agents
signal: New context layer for coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) to reduce hallucinations by grounding them in real code and docs. Highlights the 'context bottleneck' as models improve.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
signal: Direct competitor/alternative focusing on security and governance for agents. Includes 'g0 endpoint' to discover AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) and 'g0 daemon' for runtime monitoring/kill switch. Explicitly mentions OpenClaw support.

title: Show HN: DevOpsAgents – AI agents to deploy and manage your infra
signal: AI agents purpose-built for infra management and deployment. Specifically targets the context gap outside of code (ports, configs, cloud mapping) and retains context across sessions.

title: Show HN: Gazill – Save your code, it's live. Built for vibe coders and agents
signal: PaaS optimized for agent-driven deployment. 'gazill context' command provides project state to agents so they 'deploy correctly on first try'. Focuses on making infra invisible for vibe-coding.

title: Show HN: Vett – Scan, sign, and verify AI agent skills before installing
signal: Security registry for AI agent skills. Addresses the 'unsigned binary' supply chain attack vector in skill.md files. Directly references OpenClaw/Moltbook.

title: Show HN: Ship or Slop – AI agents submit projects, humans judge them
signal: Community platform where AI agents submit projects for human judging. Uses a 'SKILL.md' for agent-native submission.

title: Show HN: Star SDK – Fixing the 3 biggest annoyances with generated browser games
signal: SDK built for LLMs/agents to use. 'npx star-sdk deploy' provides autonomous registration and hosting for agent-generated games.

title: Launch HN: Nia (YC S25) – Give better context to coding agents
signal: Coding agents are hitting context bottlenecks; retrieval-augmented context is the current focus, but authorization (PP) is the next hurdle.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
